texts.zh: 我方特工已经开始接近目标驿站，并绘制了安全模式图，确定了进入位置。我们已准备好推进至下一阶段。
texts.en: Our operatives have made their initial approach to the target waystation. Security patterns have been mapped and entry vectors identified. We are ready to move to the next phase.

texts.zh: 我们的特工现已渗透进驿站的船员、访客与系统之中。关键安全中继器已被禁用，内部通讯正通过我们自己的过滤器转发。这座空间站，已经是我们的囊中之物了。
texts.en: Our agents are now embedded within the waystation's crew, visitors and systems. Key security relays have been disabled and communications are being routed through our own filters. The station's fate is in our hands.

texts.zh: 我们的情报网络已经确定了一个目标驿站。特工已经渗透完成，准备就绪。增援部队随时待命，准备登上空间站。他们将按我们的指令发起突袭。
texts.en: Our intelligence network has pinpointed a target waystation. Our operatives are embedded and ready. Reinforcements are standing by to board the station. They will strike at our command.

texts.zh: 我方特工已消灭了[target_waystation.GetName]上的安全部队，我们正在转移其资源。待行动完成后，他们将……
texts.en: Our operatives have neutralized the security forces aboard [target_waystation.GetName], and we are in the process of appropriating their resources. Once they are done, they will...

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这座驿站的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this waystation appears here.

texts.zh:
[target_waystation.GetName]遭到了渗透！入侵者以武力强行夺取了空间站的控制权，并洗劫了库存的资源。炸药引爆后，空间站被破坏，关键系统被摧毁，空间站的完整性受到损害。

尽管袭击者采取了种种预防措施以隐匿身份，但我们还是查明他们隶属于 [From.GetName]。他们必须要为此付出代价！
texts.en:
The [target_waystation.GetName] was infiltrated! The intruders used force to seize control of the station and appropriate its stockpiles. The station was then scuttled after explosive charges detonated, taking down critical systems and compromising the station's integrity.

Despite their precautions to stay anonymous, we have identified the attackers as belonging to the [From.GetName]. They will pay for this!

texts.zh:

尽管袭击者采取了种种预防措施以隐匿身份，但我们还是查明他们隶属于 [From.GetName]。他们必须要为此付出代价！

Despite their precautions to stay anonymous, we have identified the attackers as belonging to the [From.GetName]. They will pay for this!

summary.text:
# 夺取驿站 / Seize Waystation

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: common/espionage_operation_types/operations.txt:1370-1450; events/nomads_events_1.txt:17555-17855 · DLC: Nomads · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

谍报行动“夺取驿站”（operations.txt）以游牧驿站为目标，三个阶段依次弹出窗口。

The espionage operation Seize Waystation (operations.txt) targets a nomad waystation; its three stages show windows in order.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

接近目标8010 → 系统已渗透8015 → 抢夺驿站8020；“开始行动”一天后“控制驿站”8025 结算（按我方谍报资产可选掠夺、摧毁或窃取），3天后驿站主人收到“驿站被渗透”8030。

Approaching the Target 8010 -> Systems Compromised 8015 -> Waystation Heist 8020; one day after launch, Waystation Seized 8025 resolves (loot, destroy or steal depending on our assets), and 3 days later the waystation's owner gets Waystation Compromised 8030.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

8025 的选项互斥；8030 按被掠夺或被毁/被窃给受害方不同回答。

8025's options are exclusive; 8030 gives the victim different replies for looting vs destruction/theft.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

本导读未单列条件差异；条件随各事件在上文说明，阅读器按文明设定显示可能的版本。/ This guide does not list conditions separately; they are described with each event above, and the reader shows the possible variants for the chosen empire profile.
